contract: A canonical parameter pattern is read only while its exact callable dependency page is resident.
Argument row initialization and claim prefix scans run once; page-owned pattern collection/emission runs on each page and preserves other pages' rows.
Call claims and expected references retained after replay use checked caller-side references.
confirmed_reader: page-pattern-diagnostic.log: claim emitter reports diagnostic marker 0x70000002 while using a parameter pattern from another page; temporary markers removed.
